verdict.rationale: Brex markets built-in AI agents for audit, review and employee assistance, so asking whether it can connect to external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence only documents Brex's own MCP server, which lets outside AI assistants call Brex. That is the server role, not the client role this story asks about. Nothing shows Brex's agents can plug in third-party MCP servers or use their tools.
